{listed}

The conflict arrives by someone else's merge, without a single action by the author of the request: it stands until it is caught up with. New work does not fix it — it adds one more branch to the queue, growing from the same main and falling behind the same way.

What is fixed by what — the pattern git-workflow-freshness.

probe.setup:
T="$(fixture_repo_branched main RT-7-probe)"
cd "$T"
printf ".p/\n.tmp/\n.claude/\ntools/\n" > .gitignore
git add .gitignore && git -c user.name=probe -c user.email=probe@example.com -c commit.gpgsign=false commit -q -m "chore: ignore"
git update-ref refs/remotes/origin/main main
mkdir -p .claude/rt-kit/defaults .p .tmp/claude-skill-gate
cp "$DEFAULTS/gate-map.sh" .claude/rt-kit/defaults/
for r in git-workflow task-flow epic-flow turn-conduct; do mkdir -p .claude/skills/$r; printf -- "---\nname: %s\nkind: rule\n---\n" $r > .claude/skills/$r/SKILL.md; done
printf '%s' '{"exists":true,"open":true,"onBoard":true,"assigned":true,"numbered":true,"status":"In progress"}' > .p/state
cat > .claude/rt-kit/project.sh <<'PROFILE'
rt_task_state() { if [ -f "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.p/state-$1" ]; then cat "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.p/state-$1"; else cat "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.p/state"; fi; }
rt_pull_state() { cat "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.p/pull" 2>/dev/null || return 1; }
rt_conflicting_pulls() { cat "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.p/conflicts" 2>/dev/null; return 0; }
rt_pull_merged() { cat "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.p/merged" 2>/dev/null; }
rt_report_body() { :; }
rt_push_checks() { printf "%s\n" true; }
[ -f "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.p/extra.sh" ] && . "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.p/extra.sh"
PROFILE
export CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR="$T" TMPDIR="$T/.tmp/"
printf '%s\n' git-workflow task-flow epic-flow turn-conduct > .tmp/claude-skill-gate/tests.loaded
turn() { : > .tmp/turn.jsonl; jq -cn '{type:"assistant",message:{content:[{type:"tool_use",name:"Skill",input:{skill:"git-workflow"}}]}}' >> .tmp/turn.jsonl; [ -n "$1" ] && jq -cn --arg t "EXAM: passed $1 of 5" '{type:"user",message:{content:[{type:"tool_result",content:$t}]}}' >> .tmp/turn.jsonl; return 0; }
turn 5
jq -c '. + {"open":false}' .p/state > .p/state.n && mv .p/state.n .p/state
mkdir -p tools
cp "$CHECKS/rt-kit-checks.config.mjs" "$CHECKS/tree-assignment.mjs" tools/
printf '%s\n' '{"layout":{"checks":"tools"}}' > .claude/rt-kit.json
{ cat .claude/rt-kit/checks.json 2>/dev/null || printf "{}"; } | jq -c '. + {"board":{"taskKey":"RT"},"assignmentsFile":".claude/rt-kit/assignments.md"}' > .p/cfg.n && mv .p/cfg.n .claude/rt-kit/checks.json
printf '%s\n' '| Рабочая копия | Эпик | План работ | Назначено |' '| --- | --- | --- | --- |' '| rt-tools | — | — | 2026-09-17 |' > .claude/rt-kit/assignments.md
printf '%s\n' rt-tools > .claude/rt-kit/tree-name
probe.input: input_cmd 'gh pr create --title "Done" --body x' Bash "$T" | jq --arg r "$T/.tmp/turn.jsonl" '. + {transcript_path: $r}'
